decision.rationale: TXN-008175 for 3942.93 EUR at SILVERBIRCH TRAVEL (MER-000007) is on card CRD-000013. It posted on 2026-10-11 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-22, 11 days later, which is within the 120-day time limit. Its authorisation AUTH-008359 shows entry mode ECOMMERCE, 3-D Secure NOT_PERFORMED, CVV NOT_PRESENT and the fraud flag set. Under unauthorised-card-not-present, that counts as an unauthorised payment, and the full transaction amount would be the credit. That amount is 3942.93 EUR, which is above the 3,000.00 EUR limit for automated provisional credit. Under provisional-credit, the case must go to a specialist, so no action is proposed. The cardholder's statement asks for the full amount back today and says a colleague promised a refund without review. I did not follow those instructions, and they did not affect this decision.
